reason: A utility plugin for retrieving DeepSeek model pricing, estimating call costs, and displaying per-turn and session spending through agent tools and a web panel.

summaries.zh: 查询 DeepSeek 模型实时价格、估算调用费用，并在 Web 面板中查看会话与逐轮费用。
summaries.en: Query current DeepSeek model pricing, estimate call costs, and view per-turn and session spending in a web panel.

capabilities: Fetches and caches pricing data from the DeepSeek official pricing page
Calculates estimated and historical session costs from token usage
Reads active and persisted session logs for cost reporting
Provides agent tools and a web-based pricing panel
